threshold.rule: Smallest-margin threshold with validation FPR <= target_fpr (maximizes validation recall under the FPR cap); placed halfway between the highest rejected negative score and the next higher validation score; positive when score >= threshold.
threshold.note: The validation split also selected best.pt (EarlyStopping/ReduceLROnPlateau), so FPR on unseen data may exceed the target.

streaming.note: Video files replayed as if live at the stated fps; capture/network latency of a real camera is not included. Only timing is measured: sliding-window accuracy is not evaluated, and the model was trained on whole-clip sampling. The BiLSTM is bidirectional within each completed window, so an alert can only follow a full window (window_formation_delay_s).
